notes:
## New features
- Map import brings in real-world objects: OS NGD or OpenStreetMap buildings (with heights), roads, rail, barriers and walls, with party walls joined. Each street arrives as one road; roads arrive switched off until traffic is entered.
- Terrain import from Environment Agency LIDAR (Auto), LIDAR only or Google, with adaptive survey points: Detail sets how closely the terrain follows the data (Auto, Low · 1 m, Regular · 0.5 m, High · 0.25 m), and Simplify terrain reduces an existing surface.
- Optional second map image in the same import (for example OS mapping beside Google satellite), added as another basemap.
- Import defaults in Preferences > Map data: choose which layers and object kinds each import starts with (map image and terrain on, objects off with Buildings selected).
- Roads whose width and profile vary along their length, with cross-section editing, road merging and Advanced Duplicate.
- Roof-mounted plant: point sources can sit a fixed height above a roof.
- Ground regions: water preset, a G colour scale, G labels on plan and a new ground tool icon.
- Settings rebuilt as Project settings and Preferences, with search, presets and results awareness.
- Clarke Saunders padel preset (LAeq 52 dB at 5 m on the centre line).

## Changes
- Results can differ from 0.17 when recalculated: ISO 9613-2:2024 conformance fixes (connected obstacles, Eq. 18 for negative z, Eq. 25), the rebuilt BS 5228 Annex C library (+28 dB conversion, drive-by rows), spectral fixes (enclosure on-time, per-third weighting, C and Z outputs), CRN near-track and TRL night corrections, and Google terrain heights converted from EGM96 to ODN.
- Acoustic enclosures are retired: Indoor sound level is the single break-out route, and older projects migrate with a review note.
- Projects are saved in package format 2, which stores images and repeated data once (often several times smaller). AURIS 0.17 cannot open projects saved by 0.18.
- Basemap tiles are stored more compactly (map styles about 45% smaller) with no visible change.
- The Editor redraws about ten times faster on imported sites, the Contours tab opens in about a second instead of several, and the first 3D view of an imported site no longer freezes the window while roads are prepared.
- The 3D view shows real footprints and roads on imported sites, a north-up top view and crisper daylight.
- Dropdown arrows now morph between down and up instead of turning, and keep the field's colour as they open.
- Map import closes once the import has finished and reports what was added in the status bar; its close button matches the Import button in red.
- The barrier tool's instructions moved from the plan into the status bar. The Inspector shows a clear empty state when nothing is selected.
- Release notes in Settings > Updates scroll inside their panel and show when updates were last checked.

## Bug fixes
- 3D view no longer stops responding when contours are shown in 3D (the contour overlay could abort the renderer).
- Calculation worker processes now exit when AURIS quits or is force-quit, instead of staying in memory.
- Near-source contours on dense sites (P1995) no longer show spurious carriers or broken face-cover areas.
- Viewing the Composer no longer marks a project as unsaved.
- Map data key notes in Settings are no longer clipped.
